content.comment_body: I installed [product_name]. I'm using the Weekly timer example on [product_name] Web Editor and can access it from my computer via the local network, where I can adjust parameters. I can also connect from a mobile phone using Wi-Fi. However, only one device can stay connected at a time—if you try to connect both, one will remain active while the other has trouble connecting (with a message suggesting to check cable connections). Is it possible to connect multiple computers/devices simultaneously? If so, how can this issue be resolved?
From what I know, only one PC or device can connect at the same time.

Hello, [product_name] supports up to 4 connections to its built-in web server, but web browsers, such as Firefox, usually use more than 4 connections by default. On a PC, you can use Firefox and set a limit for the number of connections. To do this, open Firefox, go to Options and scroll to Performance, and there you can set the maximum number of connections. Once you set this up in Firefox on your PC, you can also connect with a second device. I have only found this solution for Firefox running on PC; so far, I haven't found a solution for Android devices. I hope this information helps.
Could you share a source or documentation for this information? Or is this just based on internal findings from [company_name] that are not published publicly?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges connecting several devices at the same time to the built-in web server of [product_name] via the [product_name] Web Editor interface. When connecting a PC and a mobile device simultaneously, one connection drops and an error message about connectivity is displayed. It is recognized that browsers, like Firefox, can manage connection limits—making multi-device access possible by adjusting browser settings. However, users lack clear official documentation and are seeking definitive resources on handling simultaneous connections.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to connect and interact with the [product_name] Web Editor interface from multiple devices at once, without interruptions or error messages.
